messages:
Olivia (Finance): Quick follow-up from today's AH finance Q&A. Starting this thread for clarifications on runway math, spend controls, and procurement fast-track. Drop short questions.
Priya (Product): Thanks. Which runway number should product teams use when proposing new customer experiments?
Olivia (Finance): Use the "planning" runway of 12 months for proposals (this assumes hiring slowdown and no large unplanned prepayments). Use "stress" runway (9 months) for contingency planning.
Hector (Eng): If infra needs to prepay a 2-month Dedicated reserve to lock price, how will that show up on dashboards vs company runway?
Olivia (Finance): Cash impact hits company runway immediately. Dashboards will show a pro-rated team-level charge over the two months for budget reporting. We'll add an example to the FAQ.
Marta (Procurement): Note: prepayments > $50k require Procurement + Finance signoff and a supplier risk checklist. Use the vendor portal form.
Sam (CEO): Important: we don't want bureaucracy to kill small revenue experiments. Can we create a lightweight path for revenue-driving pilots?
Olivia (Finance): Proposal accepted: $60k/month discretionary pool for revenue experiments. Requires 2-line rationale, manager + finance lead signoff. Retroactive approvals allowed up to $5k with post-hoc doc.
Priya (Product): For Optimize experiments (model quantization A/B), can teams toggle 5-10% traffic without prior finance signoff?
Olivia (Finance): Default: low-risk pilots (<$2k/mo expected infra diff and <1% quality delta) OK to run with post-hoc report. Anything above needs brief cost/quality note in #eng-runtime and cc finance.
Hector (Eng): Emergency infra spike during a launch  what's the fastest approval path to avoid throttling?
Olivia (Finance): Emergency: post EMERGENCY in #spend-approvals and ping finance on-call. We can approve up to $30k temporary allowance with a required 48h mitigation plan. >$30k escalates to VP.
Priya (Product): Legal/Procurement delays have blocked pilots before. Any SLA changes?
Marta (Procurement): We've added a "time-sensitive" fast-track lane in the vendor portal. When form marked time-sensitive and Sales/Prod attests impact, Legal aims for 48-72h initial review. Use the fast-track link in the portal.
FP&A-bot: Posted: "AH finance slides + committed spend snapshot" https://files.redwood/ah/finance-march-2026.pdf
Sam (CEO): Olivia/Marta  please publish the discretionary pool rules, emergency spend path, and vendor fast-track checklist in #all-hands-followups by tomorrow morning. Managers should have a one-pager.
Olivia (Finance): Will do  I'll post and pin. Also offering 30-min office hours Friday for leads to review team scenarios. Book via FP&A calendar.
Hector (Eng): Could you attach a short mitigation plan template when you post? That will speed approvals.
Olivia (Finance): Yes, will include a 3-step mitigation template and a sample pro-forma for prepayments.
Priya (Product): Great, thanks.
Sam (CEO): Thanks everyone. Keep questions here and we'll update the pinned doc as we iterate.
